notes.title: Dev Update: Terrain and Boss 1
notes.content: [h1][b][u]Hello Gamers,[/u][/b][/h1][p][/p][p]It is me, Charlie, I bring you news of the stuff I have done.[/p][p][/p][p]Terrain has been complicated, it seems every time I go to work on it, I take 100 steps forward and 200 steps backward with it, I recently outsourced it to another guy, did an alright job, but I spent so long reviewing it and inspecting it between shifts at work that Fiverr's auto-thing finished the order before I could request a revision, I've since realised that the script definitely needed more than one revision, but like I said, the dude didn't do a bad job, he's actually pretty good, you can find him on Fiverr [url="https://www.fiverr.com/somnix4"]here[/url]. Either way, with the power of my awesomeness, outsourcing, and a shitload of AI acting like duct-tape, I think it is still workable.[/p][p][/p][p]The first Boss in terms of functionality is buggy but nearly complete, there's a few extra mechanics to add (and a bunch of debugging), but it's basically there. I might be able to cheat it using the programming so I wouldnt need to animate it, but we will see. All I need is the Terrain to play ball and the Boss debugged and I'd say the game is Demo-Ready.[/p][p][/p][p]In the mean time, I'm expecting my bank balance to nosedive lmao.[/p][p][/p][p]Cheers Chaps, Charlie[/p][p][/p][p]P.S, I also attached some Dev images, they're pretty crap but rather show something than nothing ig:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45194490/d9e00abd058a8aecfc60b17ffd2283625fd790cc.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45194490/a779ca3c55909cc6d923439ab6b69f7f18b57396.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45194490/66ebf9efa01938e61caf6f1828d417087768cad4.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45194490/456874618b7027f71295e5a308b23d43857b5bbc.png"][/img][/p]
